name: reading-workshop
description: Keep answers attached to the passage.

interface.longDescription: Keep answers attached to the passage. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Find passage evidence; Build passage vocabulary cards; Plan reading chunks. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me build passage vocabulary cards.

prompts: Help me build passage vocabulary cards.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Passage Lens: Reading workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Find passage evidence. Reproducible inputs: {"passage":"Bees carry pollen between flowers. This helps plants make seeds. Bees also collect nectar.","terms":["pollen","seeds"]}
positive.prompt: Help me find passage evidence with these supplied values: {"passage":"Bees carry pollen between flowers. This helps plants make seeds. Bees also collect nectar.","terms":["pollen","seeds"]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses reading_workshop_evidence_finder with the supplied inputs. Returns {"sentences":[{"sentence":1,"text":"Bees carry pollen between flowers.","matches":["pollen"]},{"sentence":2,"text":"This helps plants make seeds.","matches":["seeds"]},{"sentence":3,"text":"Bees also collect nectar.","matches":[]}],"note":"Exact phrase matches locate evidence; they do not establish whether a claim is true."}. Shows the actual evidence result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Build passage vocabulary cards. Reproducible inputs: {"passage":"A habitat provides food and shelter.","entries":[{"term":"habitat","definition":"The place an organism lives."}]}
positive.prompt: Help me build passage vocabulary cards with these supplied values: {"passage":"A habitat provides food and shelter.","entries":[{"term":"habitat","definition":"The place an organism lives."}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses reading_workshop_vocabulary_cards with the supplied inputs. Returns {"cards":[{"term":"habitat","definition":"The place an organism lives.","contexts":["A habitat provides food and shelter."],"found":true}]}. Shows the actual flashcards result. Does not fabricate external data.
